purpose: Acquisition-owned distribution ledger records. Append-only, keyed by ledger_id. The trend-video-engine ledger is adapted into the unified view at read time by acquisition/lib/ledger.mjs and is never written here.

evidence_contract.status: PUBLISHED requires a post id from the platform. A sent request is IN_FLIGHT, not PUBLISHED.
evidence_contract.funnel: null means NOT_MEASURED. 0 means measured and zero. The two are never merged.
evidence_contract.purchase: may only be written together with purchase_evidence naming a payment-provider record.
